verdict.rationale: AFK documents automatic execution: task graphs where blocked steps resume when dependencies clear, AI-planned goals that include KPI alerts, and a user-controlled boundary between autonomous and supervised actions. None of this shows users writing their own event-triggered rules (when X happens, do Y). The automation is AI-planned or dependency-driven rather than user-authored. Missing for 10: a user-facing rule or trigger builder, documented event sources (e.g. Stripe or Mercury webhooks), configurable trigger conditions and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
